name: isBackupInventoryComplete
definition: True when the backup inventory read every enabled region with every read action allowed, nothing cut short and nothing timed out.
population: the regions and read actions the backup inventory uses
evidenceRequiredForTrue: An inventory whose scope lists no refused action, unreachable region, truncation, timeout or error.
